title: Body spin presentation
summary: Optional display transforms without changing physical rotation.

blocks.text: view.spin@1.0.0 requires core.rotation@^1.0.0, the fixed prescribed sidereal rotation queries. They use metres, seconds and radians and never step a world; dynamic N-body orientation is not implied. Each view owns hold/release offsets over borrowed body definitions. Terrain, pads and resting ships must use the same display transform to stay aligned.

holdRadiansPerFrame, resumeRatio and releaseSeconds preserve the existing 5-degree / 0.6 / 0.4-second anti-strobe defaults. Time rewind/reset clears derived offsets. Zero release easing snaps safely. No physical body angle, contact, state, save or fingerprint changes. Providers/instances release held sets and offsets; disposed views reject use. Browser/offline/node queries require no renderer or device.
